sam: FYI customer Z asks if we can run a 2-week on-prem POC delivered by encrypted USB thumbdrives. Airgapped, consented security review, and FIPS-mode required.
mika: We can. Plan: encrypted minibundle (AES-GCM) + signed delta manifests. Customer wants manifest sealed per-site with site-specific symmetric key.
nina: Notes on packaging: bundle = operator binary, minimal runtime libs, quantized model shard(s). We support per-site envelope encryption; manifest contains encrypted pointers and a public signature.
sam: They require no outbound network and a manual attestation step where operator prints a signed install receipt. Can we do that?
ben: Yes. Operator has an "offline-approve" flow: admin verifies checksums, authorizes install with local HSM token, operator emits signed receipt.json. Receipt includes bundle sha256 and timestamp.
mika: Upgrade cadence question: they want quarterly major updates only; ephemeral hotfixes allowed but require signed escalation ticket from their security contact.
nina: Delta patches supported — we ship incremental tar chunks and a patch plan file. Patching applies only if current bundle sha matches expected; otherwise operator refuses.
deploy-bot: Ingestion policy: USB artifacts must be imported via secure workstation. Checksum and malware-scan required; tag artifact with site-id.
sam: Procurement wants a flat per-site provisioning fee + optional onsite engineer day for initial install. Anything else for pricing?
mika: Add-on: FIPS-certified build + extended audit logs is a premium SKU. Quote separately.
ben: For legal: escrow option exists but prefer customer-managed HSM/PKCS#11 for key custody. We can also provide signed artifacts to avoid key sharing.
sam: I'll draft the security questionnaire answers (FIPS note, SBOM in SPDX, telemetry disabled by default). Nina can you make short runbook for USB import and attestation?
nina: On it. Will include commands, example receipt, and rollback steps (operator keeps previous two snapshots). Expected draft by EOD PT.
sam: Thanks team :thumbsup:
